annotations.title: Country climate and disaster risk profile

description:
One country's climate and disaster risk, of 194: overall score 0 to 100 (higher is riskier), class and world rank, and its climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores. response_format=detailed adds the INFORM, ND-GAIN and World Bank indicators behind them.

Use for one country in depth, ESG or investment screening, "how risky is Paraguay". Named countries side by side: compare_countries; the most or least at risk: rank_countries.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. BGD) or country name

indicators_limit.description: With response_format=detailed, how many indicators to list per dimension

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give
